14:12.race_name: Midnite, Building The Future Of Betting Handicap (GBBPlus Race)

runners.comment: Runner-up off this mark at Kempton (1m4f, Class 3) last July; first start for new trainer
runners.name: Kind Of Kiss
runners.spotlight: 1m2f French winner; runner-up off this mark at Kempton (1m4f, Class 3; 11-1) last July, before disappointing on final two starts for Kevin Philippart De Foy; changed hands in October for 21,000gns; merits a market check on first start for new trainer.

runners.comment: Three C&D wins (Class 5); "ran flat" in C&D Class 3 on New Year's Day; marginally easier.
runners.name: Without Compromise
runners.spotlight: Won three over C&D (Class 5) between October and December, rising 20lb in the weights; reportedly "ran flat" when only fifth of six (beaten over 12l) over C&D (Class 3) on New Year's Day; given a short break since, and this is marginally easier (a Class 4); chance.

runners.comment: Narrow C&D winner (Class 4; 12-1) in November; Jack Callan (1-1) returns to the saddle.
runners.name: Knockbrex
runners.spotlight: Narrow C&D winner (Class 4; 12-1) in November and, broadly speaking, has acquitted himself respectably since; stamina was likely overstretched at Wolverhampton (1m4f) latest; it's interesting that Jack Callan (1-1) returns to the saddle from just 1lb above that winning mark.

runners.comment: Positives from his fourth at The Curragh (1m1f; 28-1) in June; AW prowess & trip a concern
runners.name: Triple Double A
runners.spotlight: Won three on the bounce (1m turf, Class 6) early last season; found life tougher from an elevated mark thereafter, although there were positives to be taken from his fourth at The Curragh (1m1f; 28-1) in June; AW prowess and trip more of a concern than the 240-day absence.

runners.comment: Runner-up to Without Compromise over C&D (now better off) in Dec; decent effort latest
runners.name: Inappropriate
runners.spotlight: Won over hurdles at Musselburgh (2m1f, good to soft) last March; runner-up to Without Compromise in a first-time tongue-tie over C&D (beaten 6l but now gets 9lb pull) in December, and again occupied that same position in newly applied blinkers latest; high on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Weakened from furlong pole over C&D (sixth) ten days ago; riders 5lb claim is helpful.
runners.name: Golspie
runners.spotlight: C&D winner (Class 5) in December, and was also on the premises at Southwell (1m3f; runner-up) early in the New Year; less productive since, weakening from the furlong pole over C&D (sixth of nine) ten days ago; Tom Kiely-Marshall's 5lb claim is helpful from a handicapping perspective.

runners.comment: Close fourth over C&D latest; likely to give solid account with P. Mulrennan back aboard.
runners.name: Azucena
runners.spotlight: Narrow C&D winner in first-time blinkers (from 7lb lower) in January; has held her form well since, a close fourth (Shatin Venture second, La Rochette fifth) to Digital latest; likely to give another solid account with Paul Mulrennan aboard.

runners.comment: Went under by half-a-length over C&D (6-1) 18 days ago; only 1lb higher; player.
runners.name: Amerjeet
runners.spotlight: Sole win came at Lingfield in July 2024; placed in four of six since joining Michael Herrington, going under by half-a-length over C&D (6-1) 18 days ago; only 1lb higher, and seems to go well for Billy Loughnane (223); player.

runners.comment: Not far off the principals when fifth to Digital (Shatin Venture second) over C&D recently
runners.name: La Rochette
runners.spotlight: Fourth (beaten 1l+) to Azucena over C&D on penultimate start, and wasn't far off the principals when fifth to Digital (Shatin Venture second, Azucena fourth) here nine days ago; possible she's able to take advantage of joint career-low mark.

runners.comment: With M. Fahey when justifying favouritism over 6f here (off 6lb lower) in Dec; stable bow.
runners.name: Mount Ruapehu
runners.spotlight: With Mark Fahey when justifying favouritism over 6f here (from 6lb lower) in December; runner-up at Dundalk next time, and had excuses (caught short of room) back there latest; recently joined Iain Jardine for 4,000euros; foolish to discount.

runners.comment: Caught late by Latin Five (who is 6lb worse off) over C&D three runs back; low-key since.
runners.name: Thank The Lord
runners.spotlight: No win since February 2024; caught late by Latin Five (who, when factoring in riding arrangements, is now 6lb worse off) over C&D three starts back; less competitive at Southwell (6f) and Wolverhampton since; must bounce back.

runners.comment: Maiden (0-19); back significantly in trip (first attempt at 5f) seeking a breakthrough.
runners.name: Sherlock
runners.spotlight: Maiden (0-19); has dropped another 2lb since finishing fourth at Southwell (1m; 11-1) just under a fortnight ago; usually goes forward, but whether he'll possess the pace to do so over 5f (first attempt below 7f) is a complete unknown.

runners.comment: Held off rivals to notch his second C&D win (11-2) penultimate start; claimer ridden here.
runners.name: Okami
runners.spotlight: Held off the late finishers to notch his second C&D win (11-2; from 3lb lower) on penultimate start; respectable effort (sixth) over 6f at Wolverhampton latest; Jack Callan's 5lb claim may aid the cause from a handicapping perspective.

runners.comment: C&D classified stakes winner (7-2) penultimate start; Lauren Young's 5lb claim is useful.
runners.name: Wee Mary
runners.spotlight: Broke her duck at the 16th attempt, knuckling down in a C&D classified stakes (7-2) penultimate start; failed to figure (eighth of nine) at Wolverhampton subsequently; the 5lb claimer Lauren Young returns to the saddle, from what is a fair mark.

runners.comment: Pounced to grab Thank The Lord (who is now 6lb better off) over C&D three starts back.
runners.name: Latin Five
runners.spotlight: Pounced to grab Thank The Lord (who, when factoring in riding arrangements, is now 6lb better off) over C&D three starts back; has lacked the pace to stake a claim in two C&D starts since; likely to need everything to fall his way.

runners.breeder: Oghill House Stud & Joseph M Burke
runners.comment: 1-19; beaten a neck by Digital (Azucena fourth, La Rochette fifth) over C&D latest; chance
runners.name: Shatin Venture
runners.spotlight: 1-19, the success in a C&D classified stakes last March; has previous with any number of these, including Latin Five, Thank The Lord, and Okami; beaten a neck by the in-form Digital (Azucena fourth, La Rochette fifth) over C&D latest; thereabouts if in the same fettle.

15:12.race_name: Create Your Bet Builders At Midnite Maiden Stakes (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Slowly into stride, seventh of ten on C&D debut (14-1) three weeks ago.
runners.name: Teddy Shaw
runners.spotlight: Late to competition at the age of five; slowly into stride and green when seventh of ten on C&D debut (beaten under 5l; 14-1) three weeks ago; needs to improve on that effort.

runners.comment: Half-sister to winners Beautiful Diamond (5f; RPR 110) and Brazen Idol (6f incl AW; 83).
runners.name: Minnie Idol
runners.spotlight: Third foal from a modest dam; half-sister to winners Beautiful Diamond (5f including 2yo/Listed; RPR 110) and Brazen Idol (6f including AW; 83); yard isn't generally associated with winning newcomers; best watched unless the market suggests otherwise.

runners.comment: Step forward in third at Chelmsford (6f fillies' novice; 28-1) latest; suitable objective.
runners.name: Seven Fires
runners.spotlight: £40,000 yearling; weak finish, but still took a nice step forward from her opening effort when third to a long odds-on favourite at Chelmsford (6f fillies' novice; 28-1) 26 days ago; still getting to grips with the task but this looks a suitable next objective; player.

runners.comment: 23,000GBP yearling; second foal from a 6f juvenile winner (RPR 76); market vibes useful.
runners.name: Bannerbrooke
runners.spotlight: 30,000euros foal; £23,000 yearling; second foal from a 6f juvenile winner (RPR 76); half-brother to the 6f scorer Hackney (including AW; 84); already gelded; stable going well - three winners over the past fortnight - so positive market vibes could be worth heeding.

runners.comment: Caught the eye when close third on Lingfield debut (6f); key player under Billy Loughnane.
runners.name: Comprador
runners.spotlight: Well related; brother to the 5f/6f 2yo winner Trillium (including Group 2; RPR 109); caught the eye, getting going late, when close third to Tenbob Tommy (runner-up successful since) on Lingfield debut (6f novice; 3-1); may well better that in the hands of Billy Loughnane.

runners.comment: 20,000gns foal; second foal; half-brother to the 6f juvenile winner Magic Love (RPR 73).
runners.name: Kode Grey
runners.spotlight: 20,000gns foal; second foal; half-brother to the 6f juvenile winner Magic Love (RPR 73); the sneaking suspicion is that this already gelded newcomer promises to be more of a long-term project.

runners.comment: Best of those at double-figure odds when third to Champonie on recent C&D debut; possible.
runners.name: Celtic Arrow
runners.spotlight: 22,000euros yearling; fared best of those at double-figure odds when third to Champonie (Lock'd Up Lane and Teddy Shaw behind) on C&D debut three weeks ago; no obvious reason why she can't have a similar role to play with that experience banked; a possible.

runners.comment: Fifth, two places behind Celtic Arrow, in a C&D maiden (40-1) latest; others preferred.
runners.name: Lockd Up Lane
runners.spotlight: Onto her third trainer having spent time with Sean Davis and Diego Dias; fifth, two places behind Celtic Arrow, in a C&D maiden (40-1) latest; surprising if a newly applied tongue-tie yields masses of improvement; handicapping next.

runners.comment: Failed to build on fair C&D debut third (66-1) at Southwell; far better to focus elsewhere
runners.name: Space Moon
runners.spotlight: Placed in a C&D novice (beaten 8l+, 66-1) over Christmas, but failed to build on that at Southwell; needs one more run to qualify for a mark, with handicapping surely where her future lies; far better to focus elsewhere.

runners.comment: Fourth foal; half-sister to the 5f winner Waverley Star (RPR 64); longer-term project.
runners.name: The Cyprus Pearl
runners.spotlight: Fourth foal; half-sister to the 5f winner Waverley Star (including AW; RPR 64); doesn't hail from a stable known for supplying a stream of novice/maiden winners; safer to watch with the longer-term in mind.

runners.comment: Failed to beat rival in two starts over diverse trips (5f-1m) either side of wind surgery.
runners.name: Whisky Dreams
runners.owner: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow
runners.spotlight: Failed to beat a rival in two starts over diverse trips (5f-1m) either side of wind surgery; David Egan is a noted booking, but it could be a while yet before this £40,000 yearling is more competitive.

15:42.race_name: Midnite Are Upping The Betting Game Handicap

runners.comment: Returning from four-month absence when seventh of 11 over C&D (Class 4) latest; 2lb lower.
runners.name: Beale Street
runners.spotlight: Three C&D wins, the most recent from a 2lb lower mark (100-30 favourite) just over a year ago; was returning from a four-month absence when seventh of 11 over C&D (Class 4; 8-1) recently; now sits 2lb lower.

runners.comment: Beaten 3-1 fav over 5f here last week; this trip is potentially a better fit; shortlisted.
runners.name: True Promise
runners.spotlight: Beaten a neck by Blue Lakota over C&D in January and has posted some solid efforts since; not far off the principals (fifth) when a beaten 3-1 favourite over 5f here last week; this trip is potentially a better fit; on the shortlist.

runners.comment: Pipped on post over C&D on penultimate start; also in mix (third) over 5f here last week.
runners.name: Dandy Magic
runners.spotlight: 4lb above her last winning mark (over C&D); pipped on post over C&D on penultimate start, and again in the mix (third, with True Promise behind) over 5f here last week; virtually guaranteed to remain competitive; live contender.

runners.comment: Held off True Promise over C&D (10-1) on penultimate start; shouldn't be discounted.
runners.name: Blue Lakota
runners.spotlight: Made all and held off True Promise over C&D (10-1) on penultimate start; failed to recover from a tardy start when only sixth at Southwell (6f; with Fan Mail fourth) a fortnight ago; Kevin Stott takes over; shouldn't be discounted.

runners.comment: Freshened up since string of poor turf efforts in 2025; lurks dangerously if ready to roll
runners.name: Grant Wood
runners.spotlight: Silver Trophy winner at Ripon (6f, good) in August 2024, and beaten a head by The Turpinator over C&D (when rated 11lb higher) around 10 months ago; freshened up since string of mostly poor turf efforts in 2025; lurks on a dangerous mark if ready to roll.

runners.comment: Eyecatching third over 1m here (Class 4) on New Year's Day; can a drop back to 6f assist?
runners.name: The Green Man
runners.spotlight: Eyecatching third - no luck - over 1m here (Class 4) on New Year's Day, and could have done with a stronger gallop when a beaten favourite next time; marginally less competitive (seventh of nine) over 7f here latest; back to 6f now (a dual C&D winner) with Billy Loughnane booked.

runners.comment: 6f Redcar winner in August; absent since; is yet to compete off a mark in the 70s.
runners.name: Alpine Girl
runners.spotlight: Notched second win for Julie Camacho at Redcar (6f, good to firm; from 4lb lower) in August; absent since, a non-runner on four occasions (including when upset in the stalls here in November); yet to compete off a mark in the 70s; bit to prove off a 185-day absence.

runners.comment: Latest effort (eighth) was a step backwards; plenty of work to do with Dandy Magic.
runners.name: Maxi Boy
runners.spotlight: Winless since October 2024; form figures of 223 here through December (6f/7f) suggested he was near to ending that barren sequence; however, his latest effort (eighth) was a step backwards, leaving this 9yo stablemate of True Promise work to do against Dandy Magic; easing mark.

runners.comment: Positives to take from his recent comeback run at Southwell; 1-3 at Newcastle; place shout
runners.name: Fan Mail
runners.owner: L Bond/Sheikh Aymen Jawad Al Hamandi/Ptr
runners.spotlight: Kept on well to reel in True Promise at Southwell (6f) in October; hasn't seen much competitive action since, so there were positives to take from his recent comeback run at Southwell (11-1; with Blue Lakota behind); 1-3 at Newcastle; place claims.

runners.comment: Kept on for second over 7f here latest; dropping back to 6f shouldn't hinder.
runners.name: Novak
runners.spotlight: Back on a competitive mark, 3lb lower than when successful over 7f here (11-1) in September; kept on for second over 7f here recently; the 5lb claimer Mohammed Tabti retains the ride, and dropping back to 6f shouldn't pose a problem; merits respect.

runners.comment: No obvious excuses when fourth over C&D latest; others more appealing.
runners.name: Showtime Mahomes
runners.spotlight: Resumed winning ways at Southwell (6f; 10-1, from a 2lb lower mark) early in the New Year, having regularly caught the eye here prior; no obvious excuses when fourth over C&D latest (14-1); others more appealing.

runners.comment: Nearest-at-finish fourth at Southwell (5f) hinted he might be returning to better shape.
runners.name: Kitaab
runners.spotlight: No win since October 2024, although his nearest-at-the-finish fourth at Southwell latest (5f; 25-1, with True Promise second) hinted he might be returning to better form; the move back to 6f is a positive but stablemate The Green Man remains the likeliest of the Kirby pair.

16:12.race_name: Always Gamble Responsibly At BetMGM Handicap (Div I)

runners.comment: Returns to action over 7f (C&D winner) from 147-day absence; J.Nicholls 5lb claim is handy
runners.name: Tees George
runners.spotlight: 2-25; runner-up over 1m here (from a 2lb lower mark) in September, before a lesser effort next time; returns to action over 7f (C&D winner) from a 147-day absence; Jack Nicholls' 5lb claim is handy from a handicapping perspective.

runners.comment: Disappointing in cheekpieces at Southwell (7f) five weeks ago; headgear is tweaked again.
runners.name: Outrun The Storm
runners.spotlight: No win since June 2024; now two grades and 14lb lower; placed at Redcar (7f, good) in October but disappointing since, including in cheekpieces at Southwell (7f) five weeks ago; headgear is tweaked again (visor) seeking the solution.

runners.breeder: Qatar Bloodstock Ltd S A S U Ecurie De
runners.comment: Latest Wolverhampton third (8.5f) well advertised at Lingfield on Saturday; obvious chance
runners.name: Age Of Time
runners.spotlight: Both wins gained at Wolverhampton (8.5f/9.5f); competitive at Kempton (1m) and Wolverhampton (8.5f apprentice handicap) of late; the latest third to Poetic Force has been given a timely boost by runner-up Antiquity, a winner at Lingfield on Saturday; is feared on first visit to Newcastle.

runners.comment: Creditable efforts over 6f here through the early weeks of 2026; worth another go over 7f.
runners.name: Captain Vallo
runners.spotlight: Consistent on turf (without winning) last summer; creditable efforts (fourth to Supreme King and Howzak respectively) over 6f here through the early weeks of 2026; worth another go over 7f, even if it isn't obvious that he's crying out for this longer trip.

runners.comment: Newcastle regular; twice runner-up over 1m here last month; latest effort less convincing.
runners.name: Pallas Lord
runners.spotlight: Newcastle regular (nine course wins); posted a couple near-misses over 1m here (beaten a head, and a neck) last month; latest effort less convincing, weakening from the furlong pole when fifth over C&D (beaten over 8l) last week.

runners.comment: Low mileage but difficult to know what to expect on stable debut off a 483-day absence.
runners.name: Night Emperor
runners.spotlight: Promise for Hugo Palmer in 2024, none more so than when fifth in a 6f Thirsk maiden (8-1); joined this trainer (who has been known to do well with cast-offs from other yards) for 6,500gns; low mileage but difficult to know what to expect on stable debut off a 483-day absence.

runners.comment: Returned to form when second-best to Rajstar over 6f here (11-4) three weeks ago; player.
runners.name: Spun To Gold
runners.spotlight: 1lb below his last winning mark (6f, here) and returned to form when second-best to Rajstar over that same trip here (11-4) three weeks ago; no issue whatsoever with this extra furlong, so appeals as one of the likeliest with Paul Mulrennan booked to do the steering.

runners.breeder: Mr & Mrs C Booth & Mrs S Cammidge
runners.comment: Maiden (0-8); fourth over C&D (25-1) in December; isn't poised to make the breakthrough.
runners.name: Amelias Joy
runners.spotlight: Maiden (0-8); nearest-at-the-finish fourth over C&D (25-1) in December, but she has been unable to better that since, despite an easing mark; it's difficult to pinpoint a reason for nominating her as a future winner; focus elsewhere.

runners.comment: Never better than midfield on recent Southwell (7f) comeback; is entitled to strip fitter.
runners.name: Reenies Dream
runners.spotlight: Shaped okay on a couple of occasions on turf (7f) last year before becoming frustrating, seemingly held back by a free-going nature; never better than midfield on recent Southwell (7f; 33-1) comeback; entitled to strip fitter and is easing in the weights.

runners.comment: Edged out American Rose at Southwell (7f; from 5lb lower) on penultimate start; contender.
runners.name: Brother Dave
runners.spotlight: Scored for first time in 22 months when edging out American Rose at Southwell (7f; from 5lb lower) on penultimate start; backed that up with another solid effort (second) subsequently; is 0-9 at Newcastle but does arrive in better form than most; contender.

runners.comment: Beaten a nose by the veteran Athollblair Boy over 6f here in early January; poor since.
runners.name: Superior Council
runners.spotlight: Beaten a nose by the veteran Athollblair Boy over 6f here (7-2) in early January, but he's quickly lost his way since, posting falling RPRs of 45, 36, and 16 in three subsequent starts; easily opposed on balance of probability.

runners.comment: Suited by Newcastle but has been absent for almost two years; market helpful
runners.name: Rocket Rod

runners.comment: Shaped encouragingly over an inadequate 6f last time; possibilities off an attractive mark

runners.comment: Won narrowly at Wolverhampton last time; consistent sort who may well remain competitive

runners.spotlight: Held on only narrowly at Wolverhampton (7f) most recently but he's a consistent sort who may well remain competitive back up just 2lb.

runners.comment: Proved resurgent with close third at Southwell most recently; fighting chance
runners.name: Habrdi

runners.spotlight: On a long losing spell but proved resurgent with close third at Southwell (7f) most recently and has a fighting chance off current mark.

runners.name: Good Karma
runners.spotlight: Ideally suited by 7f and went close at Wolverhampton on most recent attempt at this trip (below par over 1m/6f since); not ruled out.

runners.comment: Has a modest strike-rate at 7f and done most of his winning over further
runners.name: Trais Fluors
runners.spotlight: Has modest strike-rate at 7f and done most of his winning over further; form dipped last time; not the percentage call.

runners.comment: No apparent excuses last time when failing to complete a Southwell double
runners.name: Operation Gimcrack
runners.spotlight: No apparent excuses last time when failing to complete a Southwell double (maiden previously); gained his win in a 0-55 event.

runners.comment: Two wins at Southwell last month; made the frame over C&D last week; remains in form
runners.name: Call Glory
runners.spotlight: Successful twice at Southwell (handicap/classified) last month; made the frame over C&D last week and remains in form; not dismissed.

runners.comment: Still a maiden but has place claims on plenty of form; refitting of hood looks a plus
runners.name: Instant Bond

runners.comment: Current mark reflects a big decline in his form
runners.name: Mighty Power
runners.spotlight: On a two-year losing spell and current mark reflects a big decline in his form; others preferred.

runners.comment: Suffered a heavy defeat in a bumper
runners.name: August Spring

runners.comment: Placed in the last two of his three starts for Aidan O'Brien; the form pick

runners.breeder: Forenaghts Stud Farm Ltd & Sam Mencoff
runners.comment: Has shown some ability in a couple of C&D events
runners.name: Multaneighttothree
runners.spotlight: Has shown some ability in a couple of C&D events, finishing 14l third then 5l fifth; remains below the usual standard required to win a race of this nature but may do better still.

runners.comment: 750,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; entered in two Irish Classics; respected debutant
runners.name: Domenico Contarini
runners.spotlight: 200,000gns yearling, 750,000gns (breeze-up) 2yo; St Mark's Basilica half-brother to 1m2f AW winner Wide Margin (RPR 78), out of 7f 2yo/1m scorer (93); entered in two Irish Classics; respected debutant.

runners.comment: Made some late headway in a Kempton maiden that has thrown up winners
runners.name: Exmoor
runners.spotlight: 380,000gns yearling; made some late headway from a difficult position into midfield in a Kempton maiden (1m) that has thrown up a couple of winners; possibilities with improvement on the cards.

runners.comment: £6,500 2yo; Sottsass half-brother to seven winners; check the betting

runners.spotlight: Sold twice, for 14,000euros then 100,000euros, as a yearling; £6,500 2yo; Sottsass half-brother to seven winners, notably All The King's Men (5f-5.7f; RPR 105); dam 1m2f Group 3 scorer (108); check the betting.

runners.comment: Likely to find better opportunities in handicaps shortly
runners.name: Leysthorpe Star

runners.comment: 550,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; by Night Of Thunder; interesting newcomer
runners.name: Midsummer Storm
runners.spotlight: 20,000euros foal, 75,000gns yearling, 550,000euros (breeze-up) 2yo; Night Of Thunder half-brother to three winners, notably Sweet Harmony (6f; RPR 95); dam Group-placed 7f scorer (104); interesting newcomer.

runners.comment: 16,000gns foal; yard isn't associated with winning newcomers

runners.comment: Two excellent wins back at 1m this year; probably found 7f against her on Friday
runners.name: Dream Illusion
runners.spotlight: In fine fettle, the return to 1m working really well this year, winning with more authority over C&D than the narrow margin suggests and impressively racing clear at Southwell after; found wanting back over 7f there on Friday but has more to come at this trip if some quick races haven't taken the edge off her.

runners.comment: Two more wins this year on Tapeta elsewhere (1m/7f); close up latest; thereabouts
runners.name: Hows The Guvnor
runners.spotlight: Has added two wins this year on Tapeta elsewhere, at 1m and 7f; useful front-running effort off this mark at Wolverhampton last week, when just behind Corundum, and he shouldn't have a problem with the return to this C&D; thereabouts again.

runners.comment: Has won on Tapeta; led near line at Lingfield (1m) latest; this stiffer test can suit
runners.name: Union Island
runners.spotlight: Awarded a 1m race on Southwell Tapeta; three 1m turf wins on stiff tracks in 2025 and Lingfield's easy test looked on the sharp side when leading near the line (first-time cheekpieces, retained) ten days ago; back up 2lb; this greater stamina test may well suit; interesting.

runners.comment: Creditable 3rd over 1m2f here latest; first 1m run since turf win in August 2023
runners.name: Jack Sparowe
runners.spotlight: Best effort since back from a short break when close up over 1m2f here ten days ago; not weighted out of it but he hasn't run over 1m since winning on turf in August 2023 so the trip does raise some questions.

runners.spotlight: Had twice gone close before making it ninth-time lucky at Chelmsford (1m6f, Polytrack) in December; bit disappointing at Wolverhampton (1m6f, Tapeta) three weeks ago, but a player if putting that behind him with blinkers now given a go.
